screen.mmdlib_companion.toggle.tip: Pause this lane to free its reserved items, or resume it.
screen.mmdlib_companion.single: One iron in, one gold out
screen.mmdlib_companion.info.crusher:
*Crusher*

Crush ore into raw materials, or stone into gravel and sand.

Place a power source beside the machine. Pause to release reserved items.
screen.mmdlib_companion.info.transmuter:
*Iron to gold*

Insert one iron ingot. The same slot holds the gold when the cycle finishes.

Supply power from an adjacent block. Pause to release the input.
screen.mmdlib_companion.info.dual_crushe:
*Dual crusher*

Two lanes share the input and output slots. Each lane reserves its own items and space.

Pause either lane independently to release its share.
